binding_algorithm: Capture target and immutable snapshot once per draw.
Ask the screen provider for descriptors at its existing_route. Resolve closures at input dispatch, never serialize Lua closures.
Filter descriptors where visible is false. Retain selection by stable id; if removed clamp prior ordinal and consume the pending edit delta.
Set kind from descriptor; all non-action/non-inspection fields of read_only screens become readonly.
Format domain and sentinel values with existing owner formatter. Do not parse labels into commands.
Use explicit short_label and compact_value metadata. If unavailable show full label/value in focused detail; do not substitute another parameter.
Select the declared layout; title/scope/status come from captured target and snapshot. No fixture numeric string is a binding.
Rendering does not advance clocks, consume random numbers, query a new solver result or change selection.

overflow.numeric: Must fit at native 8px in full 126px width; otherwise fail layout acceptance. No numeric truncation allowed.
overflow.text: ~ denotes abbreviation; full label/value must be accessible through existing detail route.
overflow.footer: single owner; held scope > modal > error > draft/queued > normal binding.
overflow.long_names: detail views use short labels with separate full owner name on selection; no scrolling animation required.

diagram_contracts.policy: Original diagram recipes are optional progressive detail views. Every semantic fact must first be available as a labelled descriptor in the data-bound screen. Diagram marks use the same immutable snapshot; absent arrays render NO EVENT, never sample arrays.

requirements: Keep existing closures and their validation. Add stable keys beside declarations; never key from rendered label.
Dynamic repeated keys use parameter id+slot, degree number, member role, group id, raw tone or event step.
Before/invoke handlers execute once, in original order, after owner/target validation.
Action route translation uses source_route_map. New visual IDs are never written to the old editor screen variable.
Presentation-only snapshots cannot be fed into get_fields as existing routes.
